title: S&C II plan #1 (PPLUL)
author: Ethan C.
desc:
This is a 6 week workout designed to build overall strength for every major muscle group. The set up of this plan is built for people have have 5 days a week available to them to go to the gym for a minimum of 30-40min. It is meant to hit every muscle group roughly twice or more times a week, which is optimal for muscle growth. The RPE range is set so you can try your hardest. However, not completely till failure, instead one to two reps away from failure to insure no injury, and you aren't completely exhausted for the entire  workout. With this plan, after 6 weeks you should observe an increased muscle growth, and be able to lift heavier. Progressive overload is listed in every specific workout, but for a quick overview every excersie has you roughly at 70-80% of you one rep max, and you increase by 5-10% every week.

(TWO SPECIFIC TESTS to track yourself, both are optional)
1. 1 rep max bench press
2. 10 rep max squat 
If you will do these, do one at the start of every week to observe your new maxes for each set.
